purpose: Refer to a short time before the present.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I saw the teacher a little while ago.
I put the key here just now.
It was raining until a little while ago.
restrictions: The interval is contextual and usually fairly recent.
mistake: Use a specific time when the listener needs an exact timestamp.

segments.role: Refer to a short time before the present. さっき + past predicate.

examples.translation: I saw the teacher a little while ago.
